author: FrozenSolstice
body:
Hey everyone,
I was flicking through YouTube and found a video about "entity 303"

I hopped onto the MC wiki and discovered that this thing is a former employee of Mojang. He hacks computers and wants to destroy minecraft. Apparently, there will be a battle in 5 weeks time.

Anyone know more about this? Is it real? Or a hoax?
